inputs.name: Jev choice answer

outcomes: auto with the chosen candidate value

semantic_ambiguity.evidence: No document or field description is interpreted here; the callback only inspects regex flags and an already-chosen Jev answer.

natural_language_understanding.evidence: Field description and document are not read here; none_of_them is a key on the probability map, not parsed text.

decision_complexity.evidence: A short chain of mutually exclusive gates (error, empty, invalid, incomplete, threshold) with no competing interpretations.
